response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive experience as a full-stack engineer with over 15 years in the field, including roles at high-profile companies like Optilyz and re:cinq. His expertise spans TypeScript, Node.js, React, and other key technologies, with a strong focus on architecture, scalability, and user experience. His contributions to open-source projects and involvement in AI-agent infrastructure further align with the role's requirements.
strengths: Deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and React with hands-on experience in full-stack development
Proven track record of designing scalable systems and optimizing performance in high-traffic environments
Strong open-source contributions and involvement in AI-agent infrastructure, showcasing adaptability and innovation
concerns: Limited direct experience with Nest.js, a primary stack requirement, though Node.js expertise suggests adaptability
No explicit mention of Vitest testing framework, though Jest and Playwright are referenced (testing experience is strong)
Primary stack emphasizes Kotlin/Java for select services, but no recent projects listed using these languages

key_factors.factor: Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and modern tooling
Gaps in direct Nest.js and Vitest experience
